button

components · 0.5.0 · E2 · aj-c-button

The product's buttons: three grades and no fourth (solid, keyline, quiet), plus the citation pair (cite, wrong), which always appear together. A link or a button element; both render identically. v4 C2 adds Ask's round pills (form pill) and the message tools (form icon with a tool).

token--aj-c-button-switch-hexposed: The switch form's height, default --tap: the parent sets it to stretch the switch to its own line (the Timeline search pill sets it while it morphs).
token--aj-c-button-restexposed: The tool option: the tool's opacity at rest, default 1. A message sets it to 0 with a fine pointer and back to 1 on its hover or focus, so its tools fade in (180ms on --gc); a pressed, expanded or focused tool ignores it.
statedefaultyes: as rendered
statehoveryes: solid fills --block; keyline's border darkens to --rule; quiet and cite turn --block; pill: --rule ground, --paper words, the count inverted (--paper ground, --rule figure); tool: as the tool option says
statefocus-visibleyes: the product's focus ring (base)
stateactiveyes: pressed 1px down, and scaled .97 under the shell's motion
statedisabledyes: only in the compact recorder's transport, --grid ground and grey, not-allowed cursor
stateselectedyes: the toggle form with aria-pressed="true" (the password is shown); the switch form with aria-checked="true" (the track filled --rule, the knob --paper, moved to the end); the pill with expanded true (its drawer is open): as hover; a tool with pressed true: filled in its colour
stateloadingn/a: a button never shows its own progress
stateerrorn/a: errors are written beside the field, not on the button
stateemptyn/a: always labelled

Timeline search’s “By meaning”: an on/off setting written as a word with a track and knob; the grade does not apply.

aria-checked="true": the track fills --rule, the knob is --paper and moves to the end.
